title: The sync gate runs backlog.py check when a tracked file is deleted or renamed
goal: kg_sync.gate_needs runs backlog.py check when a path of the range no longer exists in the tree (a deleted file, or the old path of a renamed one), since an item's touches may name it; kb/_self/git.md says that a deleted or renamed tracked file runs backlog.py check. Found by SP-noqsd4hj: a code merge request deleted five test files with backlog check skipped, so main then held 98 check errors.

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_sync as k
gone=k.gate_needs({'kb/_self/no-such-doc.md'})['backlog'];renamed=k.gate_needs({'_tools/no_such_tool.py','_tools/coord.py'})['backlog'];kept=k.gate_needs({'README.md'})['backlog']
print('deleted:',gone,'| renamed:',renamed,'| changed only:',kept);sys.exit(0 if gone and renamed and not kept else 1)

import sys
t=' '.join(open('kb/_self/git.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split())
sys.exit(0 if 'a deleted or renamed tracked file runs backlog.py check' in t else 1)
